name: ad-os-baseline
description: Windows member server baseline metrics (CPU, memory, disks, services, event log, hardware identity). R158.30 — extends R147 hardware-identity fields: adds system_info (Win32_ComputerSystem manufacturer/model — distinct from BIOS vendor), serial_number inside bios_info (Win32_BIOS.SerialNumber), network_info (Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration IPEnabled IPv4 list with virtual-adapter skip filter), per-disk model+bus_type in disks[] (Get-PhysicalDisk — first-disk model is the dominant signal), and memory_modules (Win32_PhysicalMemory — array of {manufacturer, part_number, speed_mhz, capacity_bytes}). C: drive used percentage renamed in front-end from '磁盘已使用' to 'C 盘已使用' — collect.ps1 logic unchanged. Schema is a superset of 1.0.3; ALTER migration is idempotent via INFORMATION_SCHEMA / sys.columns guards so 1.0.3 rows keep working (new fields NULL until the agent re-runs).
